title: Procedural brick-wall panel (running bond) (Python (trimesh + numpy))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Python (trimesh + numpy) that procedurally generates: Generate a wall panel as a grid of rectangular brick prisms arranged in a running-bond pattern (each row offset by half a brick width from the row above), separated by a configurable mortar gap. Panel width/height (in bricks), brick dimensions, and mortar gap must be CLI-configurable. Save to glb, obj with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
